Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $order with the order: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$order"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the order, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
